obligations.condition: Fresh dedicated email/password signup returns same-account credentials. Signup expiry shape and 3600-second expectation are separate checks.
The signup token retrieves the owned account; photoUrl is initially omitted. Exact omission is a wire-shape hypothesis to compare with production, not an explicit normative guarantee.
Set photoUrl to https://example.invalid/fireemu-profile-first.png using the original signup ID token; response reports the same UID, email and displayName marker.
Lookup reports the first URL and preserves localId, email, displayName, emailVerified and disabled.
Replace photoUrl with https://example.invalid/fireemu-profile-second.png; response reports the same UID, email and displayName marker.
Lookup reports the second URL and preserves the selected identity fields.

Attempt photoUrl https://example.invalid/fireemu-profile-refused.png with the fixed malformed token not-a-valid-id-token. Expect HTTP400 and INVALID_ID_TOKEN; this is not expired-token enforcement or independent signature verification.

After refusal, lookup with the original valid token preserves localId, email, displayName, emailVerified, disabled, providerUserInfo and photoUrl compared with the pre-refusal lookup. Not a full-state immutability guarantee.

Send deleteAttribute [PHOTO_URL] using the original ID token. Expect same UID, email and displayName with omitted photoUrl. Attribute clearing is documented; precise omission is an explicit wire-shape hypothesis.
Lookup confirms omitted photoUrl and selected identity fields unchanged; null and empty strings are distinct mismatches.
Use the original signup ID token to delete the dedicated account; success requires HTTP200 without an error.
Separate exact UID and email Admin lookups find no account after deletion. This is a cleanup control, not an additional profile-update guarantee.

limitations: No human approval. Scope is twelve cases of photoUrl-only REST behavior with no tenant and the recorded configuration.
ReturnSecureToken is omitted on photo updates; profile-update token issuance and refresh behavior are not checked.
Source describes clearing but does not promise exact omission versus null. This corpus records an explicit omission hypothesis before production measurement.

No URL syntax validation, fetching/upload, null or empty-string writes, simultaneous set-and-clear, other profile/credential changes, provider synchronization, SDK, MFA, Rules, expiry enforcement, signature validation or public npm claim.
Raw source bytes remain in the private operator cache. Auth secrets and raw account responses are not published.
